app.title: FaunBol Admin
app.subtitle: Administration panel for Bolivia's endangered species

errors.generic: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Could not connect to the API. Make sure the server is running.
errors.ACCOUNT_PENDING: Your account is pending approval by an administrator.
errors.ACCOUNT_REJECTED_REASON: Your account request was rejected. Reason: {{reason}}
errors.ACCOUNT_DISABLED: Your account is disabled. Please contact an administrator.
errors.INVALID_TOKEN: Your session expired. Please log in again.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_ROLE: You do not have permission to perform this action.
errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: An account with that email already exists.
errors.SCIENTIFIC_NAME_TAKEN: A species with that scientific name already exists.
errors.UNKNOWN_ECOREGION: One of the selected ecoregions does not exist. Please reload the page.
errors.PHOTO_INVALID_TYPE: File type not allowed. Use JPG, PNG or WEBP.
errors.PHOTO_TOO_LARGE: The photo exceeds the 5 MB limit.
errors.STORAGE_NOT_CONFIGURED: Photo storage (Cloudinary) is not configured on the server.
errors.INVALID_USER_STATUS: The user is no longer in a status that allows this action. Reload the list.
errors.status403: You do not have permission to perform this action.
errors.status404: The resource does not exist or was deleted.

login.title: Log in
login.noAccount: Are you a researcher without an account?

register.title: Researcher registration
register.intro: Fill in the form. An administrator will review your request before you can log in.
register.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 8 characters long.
register.successText: Your account ({{email}}) was created and is pending approval. An administrator will review your request; once approved you will be able to log in.

species.title: Species
species.searchPlaceholder: Search by common or scientific name…
species.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete “{{name}}”? It will no longer be shown on the public site.

form.enOptional: English (optional): if left empty, the Spanish text is shown.
form.distributionHelp: Enter departments only (e.g. “Beni, Pando”). Never exact locations: this is an anti-poaching measure.
form.invalidNumber: Must be a whole number greater than or equal to 0.
form.created: Species created. You can now upload the photo.

photo.none: This species has no photo yet.
photo.file: File (JPG, PNG or WEBP, max. 5 MB)
photo.removeConfirm: Remove the current photo from this species?
photo.availableAfterCreate: You can upload a photo after creating the species.

users.title: Users
users.name: Name
users.rejectText: Reject the request from {{name}}. You may give a reason (optional), which they will see when trying to log in.
users.disableConfirm: Disable {{name}}'s account? They will no longer be able to log in.
